■ Stage Direction
1 second of silence at start

Alright! Where to next?
Let's go find an animal stronger than a hippo!
She won this fight.

Hippos have super thick skin, so fangs don't work!
And and! Their bite force is like 800 kilos!

Guess so. ...Heh-heh.
Not bad at all, partner.

Wha—... For real?! That's insane!
Hippos are badass...! Hey, tell me more! You got me curious!

Ooh-! Ain't you something! Smart kid, smart kid!
Now if you just put some menace behind it, you'll look the part!

...The hell, then forget it!
Chii-chan~~, they're sold out~~!

It was scary, but... as her partner!
If I want to be worthy of her!

Heh. You've got some nerve, missy.
What was that? Say it again to my face!

Good grief, you leave me no choice... I'll go buy some,
so could you please keep an eye on him?

...But hippos are totally stronger than lions!
If they get serious, hippos are number one!

Hm? Yeah.
We're good. Nothin' to worry about.

I'M GONNA BUST YA UP!
I'M GONNA BUST YA UP!

Ah? The hell?
You got a problem with me, you bastard?!

Like! I! Said! I gotta buy strawberry ice cream for
Chii-chan! Get it?! You buyin' it messes everything up!

Heh-heh, really... Is that so!
Look at you, pretty badass. Nudge, nudge.

Heh. You've got some nerve, mister.
What was that? Say it again to my face!

Did I scare ya? My bad, my bad!
I'm next! Swap places with me!

P-Pokke-oneechan...?
Shouldn't we go help them?

Right? Did they get lost or something?
Guess we gotta go check on 'em.
Let's hurry up! To the zoo-!
...Tch. Time to teach 'em a lesson.

Heh, reminds me of school field trips when I was a kid~!
C'mon, run with me!

I'm still unreliable as Jungle Pocket's partner.
That's why I refused to run away in a moment like this.

While ordering ice cream, a rough-looking young man
suddenly cut in line right in front of us...!

Heh-heh! Thanks!
Chocolate for me! Make it the biggest one they got!
They're really something special.

Heh-heh! Later, partner.
Stay warm and sleep tight-

More importantly, let's eat some ice cream! Ice cream!
You bought it, right? The chocolate one.

Ah? ...What's that, kiddo? There's no way a lion loses to a hippo!
One bite with those fangs and it's over, right?

...Huh? What? You're out of strawberry ice cream?
Chii-chan said she wanted strawberry, though?!

AHAHAHA! What's with that cute squeak?!
Says here this is the "High-Impact Tiger Spot."

Ice cream? ...Wait, I want some.
Hey Trainer, I wanna eat some too. C'mooon.

Man, all that walking made me thirsty.
Wanna take a breather?

Yeah, I love 'em! It's kinda soothing~
Watching these guys laze around all day!

Still, you were scared, right? You could've just relied on me, y'know.
No need to force yourself to act tough.

Hey Trainer! This little dude says he wants to walk
around the zoo with us! Cool with you, right?!

...Ah! Then I want ice cream!
Mommy, ice cream! The strawberry kind!

You worked hard back there. I'll split mine with ya!
Come on, let's eat together!

Ahaha! Look at that huge yawn!
This guy's totally letting his guard down! Is he really a lion~?

Swallowing down my fear, I stood my ground as firmly as I could.
I couldn't let such outrageous behavior slide...!
GROOOAAARRR!!!

............
Mommy's taking so long...

Ooh, hippos! Hippos are cool too, huh.
Well, I still like lions better though.

—I'll knock some sense into ya.
C'mon, say it.

Hey now, Trainer.
What're you acting all cool on your own for?

Chocolate and strawberry, coming right up!!
—And with that, strawberry ice cream is sold out!

You step up when it counts, huh.
—Not like I didn't know that already, though.
"Please! Line! Up! Properly!!"

I-I'm sorry for talking to you so out of the blue...
I hope I'm not bothering you?

On a day off, after happening to get tickets to the zoo,
I showed them to Jungle Pocket, and ended up going with her.

Man, that was a blast!!
We're definitely going again! Bring the little kids along next time too!

Whoa, whoa, not bad, kiddo! You know a ton about
animals, don'tcha! Just like a professor!

Hm? ......Huh?
Hey, Trainer! Go stand over there!
